displayCode: Please check status of a lens
title: Lens communication fault
shortDescription: Body cannot communicate with the attached lens.
fullDescription: OM System OM-1 and Olympus E-M series display 'Please check status of a lens' when the lens contacts fail the handshake. Clean contacts, reseat, and update lens firmware.

fixSteps.title: Reseat and clean contacts
fixSteps.instruction: Rotate lens off, wipe gold pins, reattach.

fixSteps.title: Use OM Workspace to update lens
fixSteps.instruction: Connect via USB, run firmware updater.

videoSearchQuery: OM System please check status of a lens fix

faq.a: Only via MMF-3 adapter, and slower AF.

title: SD card access failure
shortDescription: File system unreadable or card door open.
fullDescription: Body shows card error for corrupted cards, counterfeit cards, or when the card door latch sensor misfires. Reseat, format, replace if persistent.

fixSteps.title: Reseat card and close door firmly
fixSteps.instruction: Listen for the click when closing door.

faq.a: V60 suffices for OM-1 4K; V90 recommended for ProRes workflows.

title: BLX-1/BLN-1 authentication or degradation
shortDescription: Battery not accepted or drained.
fullDescription: OM-1 uses BLX-1; older Olympus bodies use BLN-1/BLS-50. Third-party packs may be blocked after firmware updates; aged genuine packs show fast drain.

fixSteps.title: Use genuine BLX-1/BLN-1
fixSteps.instruction: Replace with OM System or Olympus-branded.

videoSearchQuery: OM System battery empty fix BLX-1

title: 5-axis IBIS self-test failed
shortDescription: Sensor-shift unit not centering.
fullDescription: OM's renowned 7-stop IBIS occasionally fails self-test after a drop, firmware glitch, or when using manual adapters that confuse IS focal length input.

causes.cause: Manual lens focal length not set

fixSteps.title: Enter manual focal length
fixSteps.instruction: Menu > IS > Lens IS priority > set focal length for manual lens.

whenToCallPro: If sensor rattles or visibly tilted.

faq.a: Up to 8 stops with Sync IS lenses on OM-1 Mark II.

title: Thermal shutdown warning
shortDescription: Body hot; recording will pause.
fullDescription: 4K60p, Pro Capture and long ProRes on OM-1 generate heat. Warning triangle appears before auto-stop.

fixSteps.title: Shade and cool
fixSteps.instruction: Move out of sun; pause 10 minutes.

faq.a: OM-1 allows unlimited 4K 30p, but 4K 60 can trigger warnings.

title: Olympus legacy general error
shortDescription: Older E-M/Pen bodies: internal state error.
fullDescription: Legacy E-M5, E-M10 and Pen bodies throw Err-1 on various issues. Reset menu, reinstall firmware, or service board.

faq.a: OM System continues the Pen line; support available.

title: External monitor/recorder not detected
shortDescription: Clean HDMI out fails to appear on receiver.
fullDescription: OM-1 supports ProRes RAW over HDMI to Atomos Ninja. Handshake can fail due to wrong cable class, outdated Ninja firmware, or HDMI output mode mismatch.

fixSteps.title: Match HDMI output
fixSteps.instruction: Menu > HDMI Output > RAW or 4K as needed.

fixSteps.title: Use premium high-speed cable
fixSteps.instruction: Micro-HDMI to HDMI 2.0, 1-2m max for RAW.

videoSearchQuery: OM-1 HDMI no signal Ninja fix

faq.a: No, only via HDMI to Atomos.

title: Hot pixels visible in images
shortDescription: Sensor has hot pixels that pixel mapping can mask.
fullDescription: OM bodies include a Pixel Mapping function to remap dead/hot pixels. Run once a year or after seeing bright dots in night photos.

fixSteps.title: Run Pixel Mapping
fixSteps.instruction: Menu > Setup > Pixel Mapping. Attach body cap first.

whenToCallPro: If mapping fails to remove multiple clusters.
videoSearchQuery: OM System pixel mapping how to

title: USB-PD charging rejected
shortDescription: OM-1 not charging from laptop port.
fullDescription: OM-1 requires USB-PD adapter; non-PD or low-wattage sources only charge when powered off. Use a 30W+ USB-PD charger.

title: Bird/animal/vehicle detection unreliable
shortDescription: AI subject detection loses lock frequently.
fullDescription: OM-1's AI AF (birds, cars, trains, planes) relies on firmware models. Firmware 1.6+ improved reliability. Ensure Subject Detection mode matches target.

fixSteps.title: Select matching category
fixSteps.instruction: AF Menu > Subject Detect > Bird/Animal/Vehicle etc.

faq.a: Added in OM-1 II and via firmware for OM-1.
